lesson.title: The last mile into the house
lesson.goal: HomePC reaches IspServer once the TV cable path is cabled and addressed

step.text: The TV cable ends at Modem0, but nothing joins it to the house or the street yet. Run a copper cable from HomeRouter0 to Modem0.
Run the coaxial cable from Modem0 to the Internet cloud. The modem only turns the TV line into a network line.
Give HomePC the address 203.0.113.10 with prefix 24.

check.label: HomePC reaches IspServer over the cable
